{{Quote|The Myomar shields are superb, are they not? One of our finer designs.|[[Vana Dorja]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>}}
'''Myomar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Deadalis sector/Legends|Deadalis sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="TEA-OC" /> and the site of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Imperial maintenance facilities (Myomar)|maintenance facilities]].<ref name="SWS" /> After the inception of the Galactic Empire, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Ishin-Il-Raz]] conducted a [[Massacre of Myomar|massacre]] on the planet.<ref name="Who">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] stole the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon's'']] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]] from an Imperial facility on Myomar.<ref name="SWS" />
